cio.executive_summary: WSP Global is one of the highest-conviction longs on the Canadian market. The global engineering and consulting firm is a compounding machine — it has grown revenue at a 14% CAGR over five years through disciplined M&A and organic growth in infrastructure, environment, and transportation consulting. Backlog grew 11% year-over-year and now stands at 3.2x annual revenue, providing exceptional visibility. Margins are expanding as the company integrates recent acquisitions and benefits from fixed-price contract pricing power. The long-term infrastructure super-cycle directly aligns with WSP's service lines. This is a core long-term hold for a TFSA account.
cio.key_disagreements_addressed: The only meaningful dissent came from the bear advocate on valuation (33x forward earnings). I acknowledge this risk but weight it lightly — WSP has consistently traded at a premium to peers and has consistently justified it through execution. The bear's price target of $195 requires a significant multiple compression that I do not view as likely absent a major macro deterioration.
cio.account_specific_note: For Alex's TFSA, WSP is a core holding. The TFSA tax shelter is ideally suited to long-term compounders with capital gains as the primary return driver. Recommend sizing at 6-7% of TFSA value (~$875) and holding through normal market volatility. Review thesis only if backlog growth falls below 5% for two consecutive quarters.
